detail_input.transformation: Unmodified pixel crop; no resize, retouch or generative alteration.

requirements_ja: ミディアムグレー、不透明なリブ編み、膝下丈とフィットはL1/G2を使う。
見えるつま先は、F01・F07のように不透明な布が足指全体をまとめて包む、ひと続きの柔らかな丸みにする。
指の分かれ目・爪・指ごとの凹凸を、線・陰影・外形のいずれにも描かない。肌色が見えなくても一本ずつの指の形を拾う描写は不合格。
足首の曲げ、荷重、接地に応じて小さなたるみと圧縮を描き、リブの陰影をやわらかくつなぐ。
見えるつま先の付け根・縫い目付近にはF09程度の浅くまばらな布じわを残す。位置・方向・数は姿勢と荷重に合わせ、外形の丸みと指を透かさない条件を保つ。
姿勢・動作・画角は新しく選べる。材質の参照からポーズや顔を固定しない。
靴が覆うつま先を描き足したり、靴を脱がせて見せたりする必要はない。
visual_translation_status: Operational interpretation of the user-required appearance, anchored by the approved images.

toe_finish.shape: One continuous, softly rounded, fully opaque fabric envelope enclosing all toes together.
prohibited: nails or toe knuckles visible through fabric
individual toe-shaped bumps in shading or silhouette
scalloped tips or a separate big-toe bulge
transparent fabric or skin showing through
toe_finish.allowed: Soft ribs, cloth seams, connected shading, natural ankle/contact folds and sparse shallow forefoot/toe-cap compression creases like F09, without tracing individual toes.
toe_finish.review: Inspect both visible toe areas enlarged against F09: opaque fabric, no individual toe anatomy, continuous rounded outer contour, and restrained natural cloth wrinkles. F01/F07 remain rounded-shape comparisons.

preferred_detail_input.transformation: Unmodified pixel crop; no resize, retouch or generative alteration.

cloth_wrinkles.applies_when: Forefoot/toe fabric is visible; ankle, heel and contact folds apply to the visible sock areas.
cloth_wrinkles.amount: Sparse shallow softly shaded compression creases, with broad smooth fabric areas between them; match selected F09 strength.
cloth_wrinkles.placement: Forefoot/toe seam, ankle, heel and contact areas as appropriate to the current bend, load and surface.
cloth_wrinkles.must_preserve: Continuous rounded opaque toe envelope with all individual toes concealed. Rounded means the silhouette, not a featureless rigid surface.
